title: Veedor Settlement
summary: Lock SPL tokens in a job escrow, submit evidence, and release them only when a verifier signs the canonical attestation message (checked via the Ed25519 precompile).
what: Veedor is a thin Anchor 0.32.1 shell over a no_std settlement state machine. create_job writes a PDA (seeds ["job", job_id]) and its escrow ATA. fund moves job.amount into that ATA. submit_evidence, signed by the recorded provider, starts the review window. release requires the immediately preceding instruction to be a genuine Ed25519SigVerify over attestation_message(job_id, spec_hash, evidence_hash, verdict), signed by job.verifier. A Pass verdict pays the provider; a Fail refunds the buyer.
app_note: The page at /dapps/veedor/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/veedor. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program. The hosted IDL is hand-derived; discriminators were confirmed by the verifying transactions.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/veedor/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran create_job, fund, submit_evidence and an attested release for job_id veedor-lab-job-1 (1_000_000 units of the lab mint).
try_steps.see: Program 8tfDUS6a…. Job 3kxikPVi… should be Released; the provider ATA received 1_000_000 and the escrow ATA ended at 0.

diagram: buyer --create_job/fund--> job PDA + escrow ATA; provider --submit_evidence--> UnderReview; verifier Ed25519 attestation --release--> provider ATA (Pass) or buyer ATA (Fail).
instructions: dispute / resolve / crank_timeout (not exercised in this lesson)
innovation: Authorization for release is signature-based, not a tx signer: the Ed25519 precompile verifies the canonical 130-byte message (domain agentic-settlement/attestation/v1 || job_id || spec_hash || evidence_hash || verdict tag), and the program only checks that the previous instruction verified exactly that (pubkey, message, signature) triple for job.verifier.
frontend: Generic IDL console at /dapps/veedor/. Building a release transaction requires a preceding Ed25519Program.createInstructionWithPublicKey; the generic console may need a custom pre-instruction for that step.
exercises: Reconstruct the 130-byte attestation message and confirm a Pass tag is 1, not the Anchor enum discriminant 0.
Send release without the precompile and confirm MissingEd25519Instruction.
not_covered: The x402 gateway and MCP services in the upstream repo
